title: International Motors, LLC: Upper Stack Tail Pipe Weld May crack (102 affected)
summary: Navistar, Inc. (Navistar) is recalling certain model year 2015-2016 International 9900 trucks manufactured January 6, 2014, to March 12, 2015, and 2015-2016 International Lonestar trucks manufactured February 20, 2014, to March 13, 2015.
